name: Monitor Boiler Room
implementation_notes: boiler_room_record/boiler_room_detail local SQLite tables added to localSchema.ts (CREATE_BOILER_ROOM_RECORD/CREATE_BOILER_ROOM_DETAIL, appended to CREATE_TABLE_STATEMENTS) -- mirrors engine_room_record/engine_room_detail's shape, following the hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row) pattern. This station has 15 non-time_slot columns, 2 of them enum status columns (blowdown_executed, sootblowing_executed) stored as plain TEXT locally (no CHECK constraint in SQLite local schema), and 3 free-text columns (fuel_feed_rate, id_fan_load, sa_fan_load) kept as TEXT because the paper-form units are mixed/ambiguous (Hz/%/tons, A/%)

boilerRoomRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Boiler Room screens (068/078/088) in one file, same convention as engineRoomRecordRepo.ts covering screens 067/077/087; its full unit test coverage (boilerRoomRecordRepo.spec.ts, 31 tests) is reported under this screen since it was authored first in sequence
createDraft() inserts ONLY the header row -- boiler_room_detail rows are added one at a time by the user in Form Boiler Room via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring engineRoomRecordRepo.ts's pattern
'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter is a plain COUNT(*) of boiler_room_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no filled-row filter, mirrors Engine Room's Monitor counter exactly

Router: route name 'monitor-boiler-room' registered in router/index.ts -- StationListView.vue (screen-006) already had this route name pre-wired in MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES and a 'boiler-room': false placeholder in draftStatusByType; this implementation wires the real boilerRoomRecordRepo.getDrafts() call into StationListView.vue's Promise.all, replacing that placeholder with boilerRoom.length > 0, same additive pattern Engine Room used for this same pre-existing scaffolding

Added the missing getBoilerRoomDraftsMock hoisted mock, vi.mock() registration, and getBoilerRoomDraftsMock.mockResolvedValue([]) call in every beforeEach block AND every individual it-block that manually re-sets the record-repo mocks in mobile/tests/StationListView.spec.ts (mirroring the existing getEngineRoomDraftsMock pattern exactly) proactively, per explicit task instruction that a prior station's run omitted this and broke silently -- all 27 tests in that shared file pass

deferred_items.description: syncService.ts's syncAllRecords() was NOT extended with a syncBoilerRoomRecords() function (unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water/Effluent Plant/Storage Tank/Engine Room, which each have one calling POST /api/boiler-room-records via the mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button)
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Engine Room) made the same deferral decision for the same reason. The web POST/PATCH routes are already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role) so wiring this up later requires no backend route change, only a syncService.ts addition.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task (mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-boiler-room.spec.ts does not exist) -- component test coverage (MonitorBoilerRoomView.spec.ts) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's full navigation flow in a live dev server.
